parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm with very tall R waves in V4-V6 and deep S waves in V1-V2 (Sokolow-Lyon voltage well over 35 mm), and only minor concave ST/T changes in V2-V3 with no convex or regional ST elevation and no reciprocal depression, so STEMI criteria are not met.
